mix_frequency_estimate: CHECK 85% / BET 15% at AA-class on QhJh3s 4-way OOP cold-caller 3-bet pot, AhAs combo specifically ~CHECK 80% (nut-FD blocker boosts BET slightly to ~20%)
reasoning:
Node identity: cold-caller of 3bet, OOP-early (UTG/EP), 4-way (CO 3bettor + BTN + SB), SPR roughly 1.8 (eff stack 66bb / pot 36bb). facing_bet=0 means CO has CHECKED behind preflop expectation OR more precisely the action structure here is that hero acts first as OOP-early on the flop in a 3-bet pot where the 3-bettor is the IP-most aggressor at preflop. The standard GTO protocol in 3-bet-pots, multiway, cold-caller OOP is HIGH-FREQUENCY CHECK to the PFA (the 3-bettor), specifically because (a) the 3-bettor's polar range hits Q-J-x boards well with overpairs/AK/AQ and will range-cbet small, (b) hero retains check-raise leverage with strong hands, (c) hero's range is capped (no QQ+/AK by cold-call construction — only mid-pairs, suited connectors, suited Ax bluffs and the AA/KK slowplay).

AA on QhJh3s 2-tone is structurally a check-AND-check-raise hand for the cold-caller, not a donk. The donk-bet move requires (a) hero having range advantage on the board, (b) PFA being unlikely to cbet at high frequency, OR (c) protection EV outweighing the loss of check-raise leverage. None of these hold here:
  - Range advantage: hero is the OOP cold-caller in a 3bet pot. Hero's PRE-RAISE range is uncapped wide but POST-CALL range is capped — no QQ+, no AK by construction. The 3bettor (CO) has the UNCAPPED range with QQ+, AK, AQs as core. CO has the range advantage on QJx high boards.
  - PFA cbet frequency: CO is the 3bettor, multiway pot, on a flop that hits his range well. CO will cbet a high frequency (60-75%) at small sizing. There is no 'check goes around' concern.
  - Protection EV: 2-tone hearts give villains heart FDs (~9 outs cards) and gutshots (T9, KT for 4 outs each). Hero blocks heart FD with Ah, which actually REDUCES the protection value of betting (the FD-bearing combos hero wants to deny equity from are partially blocked).

GTO mixed-strategy decomposition: at the AA class for cold-caller OOP-EP 4-way 3-bet pot on QhJh3s, the equilibrium frequency is high-CHECK. CHECK preserves the slowplay → check-raise vs CO's range-cbet → and traps BTN/SB floats. The minority BET frequency exists (AA is the top of hero's range so SOME of it bets for protection vs the 4 worse hands BTN and SB can hold that have showdown value), but it is ~15-20% at the class level. AhAs holds the Ah which BLOCKS the heart FD villains hold — this slightly DECREASES BET frequency for AhAs specifically (you want to block fewer of the hands you're trying to fold out) — so AhAs lands at the lower end of class frequency (~15%).

The consensus 5x-BET-66% vote is wrong on three counts: (a) it ignores the OOP-cold-caller-check-to-PFA structural posture, (b) it uses BET-66% as the modal action when small range-bet protection (25-33%) would be the only defensible bet sizing in a multiway 3bet pot, and (c) labellers misread AA as a value bet rather than a slowplay candidate.

Verdict: CHECK at MEDIUM confidence. The check-raise EV vs CO's range-cbet is the dominant line. BET ~15-20% as a class minority is the only defensible bet line and AhAs is at the low end of that frequency due to Ah blocking the FD.
